column2: [intro]
Joe Dassin, an artist so unique,
His light melodies make the Earth dance with chic.
Catchy refrains that make you want to move,
Joe Dassin, the pop king, with a groove.
I adore Joe Dassin, yes, it’s my passion,
His songs are divine, they give me a thrill and action.
With his smooth voice, he charms me each season,
Oh Joe Dassin, you are my reason!
His lyrics full of wit and humor bright,
Joe Dassin, a storyteller who delights his audience right.
In his songs, he tells love stories so sweet,
That make us smile, laugh, and sometimes feel upbeat.
I adore Joe Dassin, yes, it’s my passion,
His songs are divine, they give me a thrill and action.
With his smooth voice, he charms me each season,
Oh Joe Dassin, you are my reason!
[solo]
Joe Dassin, thank you for your catchy tunes,
Through your music, you bring smiles to our afternoons.
You are and will always be my enchanting idol,
Joe Dassin, the artist who makes France feel so vital!
[outro]
